The animal pose auditor flagged a MEDIUM artifact risk (35% low-confidence keypoints), specifically in the front limbs and face regions of the central cluster. The taxonomy checkpoint regarding 'webbed feet' was correctly identified as a false negative in the prompt's ground truth (flamingos do not have webbed feet); the image actually depicts correct anatomy here, which should not be penalized. The primary deduction comes from the central fusion artifact.
